content: Baek Cheon extended his blade in the 'Plum Petal Greeting' stance. His elbow was elevated fifteen degrees too high; his weight rested on his front toes rather than his center of mass. The thrust generated only eighty foot-pounds of forward momentum, trading kinetic penetration for aesthetic flourish.
critique: Sanderson/Gosu: Biomechanical angle calculation, kinetic analysis.

content: Baek Cheon danced through the forms with the effortless elegance of a court prince. His white sleeves caught the wind like swan wings, his sword tracing five petal curves in the dewy air. It was a performance fit for imperial palaces, beautiful and completely hollow, lacking the red blood and iron bone of true survival.
critique: Rothfuss/Inoue: Tragic artistic beauty, lyrical diagnosis of decay.

content: Baek Cheon spun on one toe, flicked his sword tip, tossed his hair out of his eyes, and struck a pose so dramatic you half expected someone to toss him copper coins. "Behold! The grace of Mount Hua!" Behind him on the fence rail, Jin watched while chewing a stalk of wild grass, his left eye twitching like a dying toad.
critique: Biga/Studio LICO: Slapstick vanity, dramatic posing, Jin's visceral twitching disgust.
